channel.title: Newsnavigator (English)
channel.description: We deliver the news. What you make of it is up to you.

item.title: Houthis claim six attacks on Saudi airports and oil facilities
item.description: The Houthis claim, according to spokesperson Yahya Saree, six attacks on airports, oil facilities and a military headquarters in Saudi Arabia. Saree said ballistic missiles were fired at the Ras Tanura and Rabigh refineries. (Sources: UN News, El Tiempo, Africanews, The Hindu, The New York Times)

item.title: Spain train crash leaves at least 69 dead near Toledo
item.description: At least 69 people have died after a high-speed train hit the back of a stationary train near Toledo, Spain, on Wednesday, according to several outlets. Spain has begun three days of mourning, and search and rescue work in the wreckage continues. (Sources: El Tiempo, CNA, The Guardian, France 24, Euractiv)

item.title: Christine Lagarde to step down as ECB president early, effective 7 February 2027
item.description: The European Central Bank (ECB) announced on Thursday that Christine Lagarde will leave her post as president on 7 February 2027, almost nine months before her term ends in October. According to European Council President Antonio Costa, the successor search has begun. (Sources: Europeiska centralbanken, El País América, Euractiv, MercoPress, The Hindu)

item.title: Brazil's electoral authority: rules were followed in presidential election
item.description: Brazil's electoral authority says, according to DR, that all rules were followed in the presidential election. Dagens Nyheter reports that the authority rejects election fraud accusations made by Bolsonaro. (Sources: Agência Brasil, Dagens Nyheter)

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro leaves Brazil for US after election defeat
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro has left Brazil for the US after losing the presidential election to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, according to several sources. He says he is Brazil's rightful leader, and his family is reported to have travelled with him. (Sources: The Straits Times, El País América, Buenos Aires Times, El Tiempo, The Hindu)
